mechanism.legacy_surface: local version/hash evidence binding remains backward compatible
mechanism.signed_surface: root-credentialed source attestations, freshness, distinct-source quorum, and content-addressed externalized readback
authority_bounds: source credential must match source ID key ID role and validity window
source signature must bind exact evidence ID version content digest freshness nonce and credential fingerprint
freshness must satisfy future-skew max-age credential-expiry and attestation-expiry policy
source quorum counts distinct source identities and required roles
CAS digest written must equal the signed content digest and exact bytes are re-read before authorization
authorization refuses stale missing or corrupt CAS evidence

nonclaims: no production PKI or KMS-backed source identity
no live source-key revocation feed after credential issuance
no cloud object-store replication provider-managed durability or remote availability claim
no distributed or consensus-reconciled source quorum
no proprietary access or internal architecture knowledge
